title: Finding and Registering for Courses
course_scope_description: Own enrollment in non-PME self-paced MCeLE courses and curricula; PME eligibility and staff approval workflows remain separate.
content:
Use this guidance to find and enroll yourself in non-PME, self-paced MCeLE courses and curricula. PME courses have separate enrollment requirements and guidance.

### Find and enroll in a course

1. Find the course through **Course Catalog** or **Catalog Search**.
2. Select **View** to open the Course Details page.
3. Read the course details and check the green or red **Eligibility** information to see whether you meet the enrollment requirements.
4. If available, select **Enroll Now**. If you previously completed the course and want to take it again, select **Re-Enroll Now** when available.
5. After you enroll, the course appears in **My Courses**.

Some courses require a course request. Use the following steps to open an available request form.

### Open a course request form

1. Go to **My Courses** and find the course.
2. Select **Launch** or **View** for that course.
3. Open the **Enrollment** tab.
4. Look in the **Overview** section for any available request forms.
5. Select **Request** for the form you need to open it.

user_corrections.description: Enrolled courses appear in My Courses. Course request forms are reached through My Courses > Launch or View > Enrollment tab > Overview > Request. Use plain wording such as open the form.

remaining_content_limits: Opening a request form does not establish that the request has been submitted or approved. Form-specific fields and submission instructions were not provided.
